title: 列車自動監督系統
summary: 本課聚焦列車監督排程與旅客資訊的一致性。從班距監督與瓶頸建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把旅客服務需求累積與營運異常警報排序連成可驗證的介面，最後以監督整合重播計畫整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies consistency of train supervision scheduling and passenger information. Start with headway supervision and bottlenecks to define physical or information boundaries, connect accumulation of passenger service demand with ordering operational alarms as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through supervision integration replay plan. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 班距監督與瓶頸與時刻偏差吸收
stages.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks & Absorbing timetable deviation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「班距監督與瓶頸」與「時刻偏差吸收」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" and "Absorbing timetable deviation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距監督與瓶頸」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距監督與瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway supervision and bottlenecks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距監督與瓶頸
knowledge.text: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「班距監督與瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距監督與瓶頸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距監督與瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway supervision and bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距監督與瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「班距監督與瓶頸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For headway supervision and bottlenecks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「班距監督與瓶頸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for headway supervision and bottlenecks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「班距監督與瓶頸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For headway supervision and bottlenecks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「班距監督與瓶頸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for headway supervision and bottlenecks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距監督與瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway supervision and bottlenecks"?
options: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距監督與瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for headway supervision and bottlenecks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for headway supervision and bottlenecks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距監督與瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時刻偏差吸收」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absorbing timetable deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時刻偏差吸收」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Absorbing timetable deviation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Absorbing timetable deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時刻偏差吸收
knowledge.text: 本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。
knowledge.textEn: Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時刻偏差吸收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Absorbing timetable deviation" is correct?
options: 同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。
optionsEn: The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時刻偏差吸收」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absorbing timetable deviation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「時刻偏差吸收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absorbing timetable deviation", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
平均頻寬足夠就保證每一個封包都準時抵達
操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s.
Sufficient average bandwidth guarantees on-time arrival of every packet.
Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時刻偏差吸收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Absorbing timetable deviation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「時刻偏差吸收」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For absorbing timetable deviation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「時刻偏差吸收」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for absorbing timetable deviation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「時刻偏差吸收」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For absorbing timetable deviation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「時刻偏差吸收」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for absorbing timetable deviation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時刻偏差吸收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Absorbing timetable deviation"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時刻偏差吸收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Absorbing timetable deviation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for absorbing timetable deviation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for absorbing timetable deviation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時刻偏差吸收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Absorbing timetable deviation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction.
quiz.explanation: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
